en: Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a seated Chinese woman in traditional dress beside a small round table with a teacup and candle. Caption in English, German, and French appears below the image. The reverse is a divided back with 'POST CARD', publisher credit 'L. Wannieck - Peking', handwritten Christmas greeting, and an address to Hotel des Wagons-Lits in Peking with postal marks.
